kurz: Graubünden barley soup turns thick and silky because the barley releases starch during long simmering. Bacon and air-dried beef bring the depth.
bild_im_kopf: Like a fire slowly turning to embers: only after hours is the full warmth there.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Sweat bacon and diced vegetables in a little fat
schluesselmomente.warum: The fat from the bacon carries the aromas through the whole dish.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Add barley, top up with water or stock and simmer gently for 1–2 hours
schluesselmomente.warum: The barley grains gradually release starch and thicken the soup.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Cook air-dried or smoked beef in it
schluesselmomente.warum: Aged, dried meat brings a lot of [[umami|umami]] to the broth.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Finish with cream and adjust the seasoning
schluesselmomente.warum: Fat rounds it off. Salt only at the end, because the soup reduces as it cooks.
